content.title: 11/41 Villas and VRD Works
summary: Delivery of 11 individual villas within the Les Pastorales development in Staoueli, combining ground floor plus 2 upper floors of residential volume with integrated roads and utility networks (VRD).
This residential parcel focuses on low-rise volumetric organisation, site circulation, and durable exterior works to establish a coherent domestic scale.
description: The 11 villas constitute a specific phase of a larger 41-villa master plan. The scope of execution required a coordinated sequence of all-trades delivery (TCE), facade articulation, and the installation of dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD) to secure independent site connections.

Constructed with a structural profile of ground floor plus 2 upper floors, the villas feature integrated balconies, structural guardrails, exterior render coatings, and dedicated access pathways to define the street-level residential frontage.
content.authority: A residential delivery defined by precise structural execution, site-specific utility networks, and coordinated facade finishes.

faq.question: What is the scope of the 11/41 Villas project in Staoueli?
faq.answer: The project comprises the construction and all-trades delivery of 11 individual R+2 villas, executed as part of a larger 41-villa residential development in Les Pastorales, Staoueli.

faq.question: What civil and infrastructure works were executed on site?
faq.answer: The 11 villas sit inside a 41-villa programme and rely on a precise sequence of TCES, VRD, facade work and exterior networks to create a finished residential setting.

faq.question: What are the architectural characteristics of the villas?
faq.answer: Each villa is organised as a ground floor plus 2 upper floors (R+2), featuring contemporary facade articulation, glass-railed balconies, and integrated garage access.
